summary.text: Jaime Greene is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 65 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jaime Greene's general-election opponent is James O'Brien (D).
She served in the U.S. Navy, was a member of the Richmond City Council, and chairs the Communications and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jaime Greene lives in Richmond, Michigan, graduated from Henry Ford II High School, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1996 to 1999.
She earned a B.A. in communications from Oakland University in 2004 and an M.A. in human services from Liberty University in 2009.

Her career experience includes working as a support representative with Classical Conversations, a veterans counselor, a technical director with Faith Lutheran Church, and a cryptologist with the U.S. Navy, and she served on the Richmond City Council.

Greene assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023; in 2023-2024 she was Minority Vice Chair of the Education Committee, and in 2025-2026 she chairs the Communications and Technology Committee and serves on the House Oversight Committee.
